comment: What tools/image/smoke.mjs needs that is particular to this repo: the bin (its log topic), a command that makes one request (a POST: the mock answers by path, whatever the method), the exit code of a network error (6 in this CLI), the mock answer to that request (by path, under --base-url http://mock:8080), and a string the printed answer contains. The answer: three live HELCOM PLC stations of 2026-11-19.
